result.scientific_strategy:
## f3356be0-50ce-45d0-a495-b909a50b054c / Scientific strategy

**Current synthesis:** The campaign objective is at least 98% success, or 196/200 episodes, on the official reach-and-hold panel. The selected baseline policy remains the strongest measured lineage: it reached 51/100 on the first fresh research panel, 101/200 on the reused task-reference panel, and 105/200 on the experiment-2 research panel. The transferred symmetric extreme-angle sampling intervention reached 77/200 and 71/200 on that panel, while the unchanged baseline reached 105/200. The campaign therefore has demonstrated partial learned behavior but no policy close to the objective. The current interpretation is that one-sided target coverage is not an adequate explanation for the residual failures under the tested transfer and budget; control, reward, representation, and continued optimization remain unresolved alternatives.

**Lessons and limits:** The fresh baseline improved from 44% at checkpoint-65536 to 51% at checkpoint-120832, with training reward improving from -2591.08 to -598.35, but training success remained zero and this does not establish that later unchanged training will improve. The adapted run's 0.02 training success and late reward peak did not predict measured usefulness: its checkpoints reached 38.5% and 35.5% versus the unchanged baseline's 52.5%, with paired comparisons favoring the baseline 37-9 and 40-6. Neither adapted checkpoint improved the extreme sectors; the baseline still achieved 6/34 in [-180, -120) and 0/38 in [120, 180], while adapted checkpoints achieved at most 3/34 and 0/38. The intervention also reduced the baseline's strong [-120, 0) sector from 58/61 to 40/61 or 36/61. Complete uninterrupted hold success is authoritative; proximity, partial hold time, and training reward are incomplete signals. The task-reference panel is reused and selection-contaminated, and the experiment-2 panel is development evidence rather than official confirmation. The unchanged policy I/O remains a 14-value observation and 2-value action mapping, so continuation from the selected artifact preserves the learned task semantics; that compatibility does not imply the optimizer has reached a useful plateau.

**Open questions:** It is unknown whether the unchanged baseline recipe can improve complete hold success beyond 120,832 accumulated steps, has plateaued, or will degrade with further updates. It is also unresolved whether the persistent positive-extreme and intermittent-hold failures arise primarily from control, reward credit assignment, observation representation, or training dynamics. No development measurement establishes readiness for terminal assessment.
